name: baf-platform
description: Bookings and Flights — headless travel meta-search monorepo (affiliate, no payments).

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run -w @baf/search-api dev" "npm run -w @baf/web dev"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @baf/search-api dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @baf/web dev
